npc.name: Maren
npc.hello: You came ashore at dawn. Few do, these days. I am Maren, I keep the fire.
npc.quest1: Six ember shards fell from the mountain's mouth when it last woke. Together they lit the beacon that kept the dark away.
npc.quest2: Bring them to the altar here, one by one or all together, and light the beacon. Take care: stone golems sleep over the shards.
npc.h1: One lies in the wreck on the east beach. Walk along the shore.
npc.h2: Another rests among the whale bones on the south shore.
npc.h3: Look for the old ruin in the forest. A golem sleeps nearby.
npc.h4: A shard lies on the little island in the lake. You will have to swim.
npc.h5: The standing stones in the highlands hold one, and a golem guards it.
npc.h6: The last is on the rim of the caldera, and the Warden will not give it up. Strike it when it kneels.
npc.h_all: You have them all. Put them on the altar and light the beacon.
npc.night1: At night wraiths rise. Only fire shows them to you, and your lantern when it burns bright.
npc.night2: Stay near a fire and they will not come. Rest here, and I will keep your place in the book.
npc.bring: You carry embers! Put them on the altar, there by the big stone.
npc.beacon: All six! Go to the beacon and light it. The island has waited long.
